questions.title: Which European country will announce a complete drought-related shutdown of its nuclear power generation between August 1 and August 13, 2026?
questions.background: Nuclear reactors require reliable cooling-water supplies. Low river levels can force reactors to shut down, potentially disrupting national electricity supplies.

Resolution Conditions : Identify the European country that announces, between August 1 and August 13, 2026, a shutdown covering its entire operating nuclear fleet because drought has left insufficient river water for cooling. Still, Hungary stays #1 at 0.55 because Budapest Danube hit an all-time record low of 10 cm (vs 33 cm in 2018), hot/dry weather continues all week with Reuters noting Paks is still expected to power down later this week, and Paks' crunch timeline (Tue-Wed) remains tight. With Hungary's total shutdown no longer a fait accompli, Romania has a strong path to announce a complete fleet shutdown inside Aug 1-13 (note sister QID 683823 already resolved to Hungary on July 30). Holding Bulgaria (0.04; Kozloduy safe >=3 weeks), Slovenia (0.015), and Switzerland (0.005) (sum = 0.99).

local_articles.title: Korea, Argentina agree to enhance cooperation on critical minerals: official
local_articles.snippet: BUENOS AIRES — Korea and Argentina agreed Friday to strengthen their bilateral cooperation on critical minerals, including by pursuing joint projects across the entire lithium value chain, a presidential official said Friday. A memorandum of understanding (MOU) toward that end was signed on the sidelines of a bilateral summit between Korean President Lee Jae Myung and his Argentine counterpart, Javier Milei, in Buenos Aires. Under the MOU, the two countries will share information on their respective policies regarding critical minerals and related investment systems, while promoting bilateral corporate investment and pursuing joint projects across the entire lithium value chain, including exploration and mining, according to National Security Adviser Wi Sung-lac.
